name: job-fair
description: Job fair portal. The website is in frontend/ (deployed on Vercel) and the server is in backend/ (deployed on Railway). These commands only make it easy to run both on one computer.
author: Yaticorp

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-mongo.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
